Sonic's parents, a wolverine father and Whisper the Hedgehog

sketches.alt: 1827 - Sonic has fallen from a tree and wonders, 'Hey, wasn't I supposed to break my bones?' Meanwhile, Tails is drinking from the magical spring and Shadow is hauling lumber. 1914 - Eggman, who wanted the magical spring, has been killed. Sonic kisses his love interest Amy, thinking, 'Please drink the spring water so we can be together, forever.' Shadow, who killed Eggman by pistol-whipping him, and Tails leaves, with Shadow thinking, 'Can she not? I outlived Maria and it was terrible.' 2002 - Sonic has approached Amy's grave, reading 'AMY ROSE / Loving wife and mother / 1899-1999'. He sheds a tear, thinking, 'She chose a mortal life...' Outside of the story, at school desks, Amy, holding Tuck Everlasting in her hands, looks back at Shadow.
sketches.description: Tuck Everlasting (specifically the 2002 movie) was a good movie...

sketches.alt: Sketch of 'Knuckles and Rouge's echidna daughter (they got her from genetic engineering)' 'Fossil'. 'I designed her as 80% hottie, 15% goth (striked out) dark, 25% adventurer. She's adventurer derived. (Maybe I took took much from Lara Croft.) Alexander's fighter-derived.

Shadow, with tears in his eyes, hugs Blaze, which surprises her. The quote besides it reads: 'And I don't want the world to see me / 'Cause I don't think they'd understand. / When everything's made to be broken, / I just want you to know who I am.' - 'Iris' (1998) by the Goo Goo Dolls

'Quickly doodle Sonic and friend's [sic] Next Generation!'. Small head icons of Accel the Hedgehog (male) and Grace the Hedgehog (female) (Sonamy), Night the Cat (male) and Maria the Hedgehog (female) (Shadaze), Bliss the (Corsac) Fox (non-binary) (Silvemedy), Alexander the Bat (male, Knuxouge), and Lever the Rabfox (female) and Alphabet the Fox (trans female) (Tailsream).
Pika holding a Calico Critter and a Labubu, asking 'What the heck are these bunny-goblin things?'
Shadow kneels and hugs Amy from behind. Amy kneels and hugs Sonic from behind. Sonic is just sitting with his hands clasped. They're all wearing casual clothing.

Knuckles is waiting outside Rouge's penthouse door, wearing 'a blazer he found at Walmart', and sweating. The door opens and Rouge is posing coy in her lacy black cocktail dress. She says, 'Heyyy handsome...' Knuckles gets so flustered, thinking, 'Dang, she's hot!'. Monologue: 'I feel like I'm the luckiest dude in the world, even though I'm a hunk.'
Older movie Sonic and Amy, in a tuxedo and gown respectively, holding hands as they dash together.
sketches.description: Movie Sonamy!

sketches.alt: Remedy the (Corsac) Fox running. Friendship bracelet and ankle cuff ('Inspired by gel bracelets') are labeled.
sketches.description: She's Floee the Fox's successor, if you've grown with  me

sketches.alt: Movie Amy, in a two-piece swimsuit, hugging movie Sonic, in swim trunks
sketches.description: MORE MOVIE SONAMY!!!

sketches.alt: Comic titled 'Mythical and the PrincessPandaLovers': Mythical nervously exclaims, 'I took 10 mg of extended-release melatonin and got a nightmare with Slender Man... (illegible)', Enchanted the rabbit replies, 'Who's Slender Man?', Mythical answers 'He's a horror character. Just look at him.' and shows on her phone, Enchanted looks and exclaims, 'Ha! You're scared of what's basically a living mannequin-' (Mythical has an embarrassed face), and then Slender Man suddenly appears behind Mythical, shocking her and Enchanted. Drawing of Mythical sitting upright in bed wide awake, accompanied by a Shadow the Hedgehog Squishmallow ('WHY DOES IT LOOK CREEPY'), captioned, 'I know what insomnia typically is: Not being able to fall asleep. But waking up in the middle of the night and not being able to sleep afterwards is a whole another level.' Drawing of a photograph labeled '03/10/00', depicting Cream's rabbit parents, father labeled 'English Spot' and Vanilla labeled 'Holland Lop', with a newborn Cream. Then, a drawing of a grown-up Cream and Tails with their newborn Lever the Rabfox.

Comic in which Mythical asks Queen the Polar Bear, holding up a drawing of herself, 'Hey, should I fork like $150 for a Budsies of my persona or maybe a little less on Etsy?', Queen responds, 'Wouldn't Build-a-Bear be cheaper?', and Mythical exclaims, 'THERE ARE NO RED WOLVES.' Drawing of Mythical wearing sunglasses and glow bracelets and pointing to the Moon with fireworks in the sky: 'BOOM, BOOM, BOOM / EVEN BRIGHTER THAN THE MOON, MOON, MOON. (I just realized wolves howling and moons are related.)' Comic captioned 'Poor Sonic AU', in which adult Amy is reading a bridal magazine and tells adult Sonic, 'Look at all those beautiful wedding gowns and dashing tuxedos.'
sketches.description: I have this AU in which Sonic and Amy are poor.

sketches.alt: Amy, 'Age: 6', says to Sonic, 'Age: 8', 'When we grow up, we'll get married. I will be wearing a big poofy dress.' Sonic replies, 'Aren't we poor!' Transition to wedding many years later, with Sonic and Amy 'wearing borrowed clothes': a tuxedo and wedding gown.
sketches.description: More poor Sonic AU

sketches.alt: 'And I'm only gonna pierce my left ear.' Sonic inserts a gold earring. 'And I've been working on this mustache all summer long.' He, in a tank top, brushes his finger against his forming mustache ('Hand small, but I overdid fixing its anatomy'). He then puts on his tuxedo jacket, singing 'Turn your back on Mother Nature... Everybody wants to rule the world'. 'And my favorite band will always be Tears for Fears.'
'And I'm gonna wear a pink tux to the prom.' Sonic arrives in a pink tuxedo. Amy is excited, while Shadow and Blaze merely look up.

'Testing "slightly more humanoid proportions", like for Sonic characters.' A male jerboa jumps in. The same jerboa is then shown clothed in a tank top and shorts. There is a small drawing of the unclothed jerboa being teased by a female 'mourning dove'. 'Eh... trying out a more humanoid style.'

Female bird in a bikini noticing a male deer in swim trunks and lounging in a beach chair and a female orchid mantis in a bikini. In an office setting, a male paper wasp in an office uniform walks by, while a female fossa in a similar uniform, sitting at a desk and holding a cup of coffee, notices. All anthros are in a more humanoid style.

Male gamer snowy owl leans on his gamer chair ('Chairs needs to be leaning back more.'), accompanied with a female gamer sea lion lounging on hers and with a controller in her hands. All anthros are in a more humanoid style.
A worried Tails sings 'So please, Mr. Bully, tell me what I've done. You know I have no dad... livin'... my mom'. A happy Sonic then sings, ''Cause I'm hopeful, yes I am hopeful for today'.
Sonic and Jet racing upwards (with Jet on Extreme Gear, like always), accompanied by the text 'Hey driver to the top of the world'
sketches.description: "Hey Driver" by Lucky Boy Confusion fits Sonic the Hedgehog to an absolute tee. Just listen.

sketches.alt: Shadow holding his Chao version, and Sonic running with his Chao version. Sonic only wearing shorts and socks sitting drowsily. 'Sonic going to sleep' 'I like how I drew his nose here' The Sonic in the shorts but he's rising and shining!
sketches.description: I drew the sleepy Sonic while tired. I remember being on the verge of tears trying to draw good anatomy while tired. Like go to bed, sis. It isn't the end of the world if you don't draw for a while.

sketches.alt: Sketches of hands 'Quick gesture drawing of hand' '(Yeah, the fingers look too short.)' 'I like this better.' 'I like it!' (with Chao doodle)
sketches.description: HANDZ. It's satisfying when you're drawing anatomy relatively well after years of drawing. (Drawing becomes less mystifying when you realize it's just how well your hand and eyes coordinate with your mind.)

sketches.alt: Sonic lifting Blaze's hand up as she turns towards him, all in my original art style. Sonic is dressed in a T-shirt and jeans. Blaze is in an open short-sleeved jacket, top, and tight jeans.
sketches.description: Sonic and Blaze in my original art style

sketches.alt: Comic in which an exhausted Mythical says, 'I feel so tired and burnt out...', Enchanted the rabbit replies, 'How about you rest with no phone?', and Flora the sea lion, with a notepad and pencil in hand, replies, 'Arts and crafts'. Then Fuzzy the red fox, Laughing the reticulated giraffe, and Blooming the sambar deer. Cute head icons of Mythical the wolf, Enchanted the rabbit, Darling the koala, Flora, Fuzzy, Queen the polar bear, Laughing, and Blooming.
sketches.description: More Mythical and the PrincessPandaLovers

sketches.alt: 'Meanwhile, Shadow and Blaze can communicate by tapping into the Chaos / Sol Energy.' Shadow says, 'Can you hear me, Blaze?' Blaze, signing at her desk, responds, 'Yes, I can, dear.' Next, Silver is levitating with a stopwatch he's pointing at, thinking, 'It's weird our technology has advanced so much and no one has developed Chaos Energy powers yet.' ('I hate drawing Silver's boot soles.')

Amy dressed in 2000s fashion floating in the clouds, surrounded by a floating Tamagotchi and winged email icon. '"She's got her head in the clouds / (Sharada, Sharada) / Don't know if she'll come down. / (Sharada, Sharada)" - "Sharada" (2004) by Skye Sweet[nam]'
Storm is scarfing down a whole turkey while Knuckles watches. Meanwhile, Jet is eager to eat stuffing, 'Mmm, stuffing!'
sketches.description: Happy late Thanksgiving!

sketches.alt: 'I make them good girls go bad...'. Sonic and Blaze dancing together. Sonic is dressed in a T-shirt, jeans, and watch and Blaze is dressed in a T-shirt, loose cardigan, and tights.
Remedy (climbing a tree), Blaze, and Marine in futuristic fashion. Remedy is wearing a short-sleeved jumpsuit, Blaze is wearing a special tailcoat, and Marine has a jacket.
sketches.description: Here's how I'd envision what Silver's friends, Remedy, Blaze, and Marine, would be wearing in Silver's future.

sketches.alt: Shadow, in swim trunks, and Blaze, in a tankini, are walking down the beach together, holding hands.
sketches.description: This was a redrawing of a Shadaze drawing I made when I was 13. It still can be found on my DeviantArt. In particular, it is still hanging up on the closet door in my childhood home.

Sonic dressed as Rudolph and running. 'Run, run, Rudolph, / Santa has to make it to town'
